(ifc.) encircled, ensnared, being in a person's power, ib.
पर्य्-आ-√ गल् P. -गलति, to drop or trickle down on every side, Bhaṭṭ.

पर्य्-आ-√ गा (only aor. -आगात्, 3. pl. -आ॑गुर्), to pursue, be intent upon (acc.), RV. i, 88, 4;
to perform a revolution, elapse (as time), MBh.
पर्य्-आ-√ चर् P. -च॑रति, to come near, approach, RV.; AV.
पर्य्-आचान्त mfn. (√ चम्) sipped prematurely (as water in आचमन, q.v.)
पर्य्-आचान्त n. (with अन्नम्) food left by a person after sipping, Mn. iv, 212.
पर्य्-आ-चित n. (prob.) N. of a place g. आचितादि.
पर्याण n. (for परि-याण; √ या) a circuit (or mfn. forming a c˚), AitBr. iv, 17
a saddle, Var.; Kathās.
पर्या˚णय Nom. P. ˚यति, to saddle, Nalac.
पर्या˚णित mfn. saddled, Kād.
पर्य्-आ-णह् (√ नह्) P. -णह्यति to cover up, cover, ŚBr.
पर्य्-˚आ॑णद्ध mfn. covered (?), AV. xiv, 2, 12.
पर्य्-˚आणहन See सोम-पर्याण्˚.

पर्य्-आ-णी (√ नी) P. -णयति (but Impv. पर्य्-आनयत, MBh. i, 5446), to lead round, ŚBr.; GṛS.; MBh.;
to lead or bring forward, RV.; MBh.
पर्य्-आ-√ तन् P. -तनोति, to spread round, encompass, surround, ŚBr.
पर्य्-आ-दान n. (√ दो ?) end, exhaustion, Divyāv.
पर्य्-आ-√ द्रु P. -द्रवति, to run to and fro, BhP.
पर्य्-आ-√ धा P. -दधाति (Impv. 2. pl. -धत्त), to lay round, surround (with fire), AV.

पर्य्-आधानेज्य n. du. kindling the sacred fire and offering oblations previously (to an elder brother), Baudh.
पर्य्-आहित m. an elder brother previously to whom the younger has set up the s˚ f˚, Gaut.; ĀpŚr.
पर्य्-आप्त mfn. obtained, gained, Uttarar.
finished, completed, full, Up.; Kālid.
extensive, spacious, large, Hariv.
abundant, copious, many, Kāv.
sufficient for (dat. or gen.)
adequate, equal to, a match for (gen. dat.; loc. or inf. cf. Pāṇ. iii, 4, 66), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
limited in number, MW.
पर्य्-आप्तम् ind. fully, completely, enough, one's fill, Kāv.
willingly, readily, L.

पर्य्-आप्त—काम mfn. one whose desires are accomplished or allayed, MuṇḍUp.
पर्य्-आप्त—चन्द्र mf(आ)n. adorned by the full moon (as a night), Kum.
पर्य्-आप्त—ता f. copiousness, abundance, Kathās.
satisfaction, gratification, MW.

पर्य्-आप्त—नयन mfn. having a sufficient number of eyes, Hariv.
पर्य्-आप्त—भोग mfn. possessing or enjoying a sufficiency, Mn.; Yājñ.
पर्य्-आप्त—वत् mfn. able, capable, Ragh. (cf. अ-पर्य्˚).
प॑र्य्-˚आप्ति (प॑र्य्-), f. end, conclusion, ŚBr.
entireness, fulness, sufficiency, MBh.; Kathās.; Rājat. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 4, 66)
adequacy, competency, fitness for (comp.), Kathās., Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 3, 16
obtaining, acquisition, L.
self-defence, warding off a blow, L.
(in phil.) distinction of objects according to their natural properties, W.
पर्य्-आ-√ पत् P. -पतति (pf. 3. pl. -पेतुः), to hasten forth, hurry or run away, MBh.; R.
पर्य्-आ-पतत् mf(अन्ती)n. hurrying or rushing about, Śiś. v, 24.
पर्य्-आ-√ प्लु Caus. -प्लावयति, to make float round, TBr.
पर्य्-आ-˚प्लाव॑ m. turning round, revolution, TS.; Kāṭh.
पर्य्-आ-˚प्लुत mfn. surrounded, encircled, MBh.

पर्य्-आ॑भृत mfn. fetched or extracted from (abl.), ib.
पर्य्-आ-√ मुच् P. -मुञ्चति, to make loose or take off on all sides, Sāṃkhyak., Sch.
पर्य्-आ-√ मृश् P. -मृशति, to subdue, conquer, overpower, MW.
पर्य्-आरि॑न् mfn. (√ 4. ऋ) toiling a long time without success, attaining one's object in the end (after long effort), TS.; ŚBr.; Kāṭh.
पर्य्-आ-√ रुह् P. -रो॑हति, to rise from (abl.), RV.
पर्याली ind. (with √ कृ, भू, and अस्) g. ऊर्य्-आदि.
पर्य्-आ-√ लोच् Caus. -लोचयति (ind.p. -लोच्य), to look after, attend to, consider, ponder, Subh.; Vet.
पर्य्-आ-˚लोच m. consideration, reflection, HPariś.

पर्य्-आ-˚लोचना f. id., ib.; ĀpŚr., Sch.
plan, design, Kathās.

पर्य्-आ-˚वर्तन n. coming back, returning, KātyŚr., Sch.
पर्य्-आ-˚वर्तित mfn. turned round, subverted, reversed, MW.
पर्य्-आ-वृत mfn. (√ 1. वृ) veiled, covered, Mālatīm.

पर्य्-आ-√ श्वस् P. -श्वसिति, or -श्वसति, to breathe out, recover breath, take heart, be at ease, MBh.; R. :
Caus. -श्वासयति, ˚ते, to comfort, console, MBh.
पर्य्-आ-˚श्वस्त mfn. comforted, consoled, tranquil, at ease, MBh.

पर्य्-आ-√ हृ P. -हरति, to hand over to (dat.), ŚBr.;
to overturn or turn upside down, ib.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
पर्य्-आ-˚हार m. a yoke worn across the shoulders in carrying a load, L.
conveying, W.
a load, ib.
a pitcher, ib.
storing grain, ib.
पर्य्-आ-√ ह्वे Ā. -ह्वयते, to pronounce the Āhāva (s.v.) before and after, AitBr.
पर्य्-आ-हाव m. a partic. formula which precedes and follows a verse, ib.; Sāy.
पर्युक m. N. of a man, Rājat.

accord. to Sāy. = परि-युक्त = विनियुक्त.

पर्य्-˚उक्षण n. sprinkling round, sprinkling, GṛŚrS.
पर्य्-˚उक्षणी f. a vessel for sprinkling, Kauś.

to appear to (acc.), TāṇḍBr.
पर्य्-˚उत्थान n. standing up, rising, L.
पर्य्-उत्सुक mf(आ)n. very restless, much excited, R.; Mālav.
eagerly desirous, longing for (dat.), Ratnāv.
पर्य्-उत्सुक—त्व n. an ardent longing, Ragh.
पर्य्-उत्सु˚की-√ भू to be sorrowful or regretful, Śak.
पर्य्-उत्-√ सृज् P. -सृजति, to give up, leave, abandon, L.
पर्य्-उद्-अञ्चन n. (√ अञ्च्) debt, L.
पर्य्-उदयम् ind. about sunrise, KātyŚr.
पर्य्-उद्-√ 2. अस् P. -अस्यति, to reject, exclude, MBh.
पर्य्-उद्-˚असन n. exclusion, Yogas., Sch.
पर्य्-उद्-˚असितव्य mfn. to be excluded or denied, Pat.
पर्य्-उद्-˚अस्त mfn. rejected, excluded, Kull. on Mn. iii, 280
पर्य्-उद्-˚अस्त—त्व n., ĀpŚr., Sch.; Sāy.
पर्य्-उद्-आस m. a prohibitive rule, exception, Pāṇ., Sch.; Kull.
पर्य्-उ॑द्-भृत mfn. (√ भृ) brought out, extracted from (abl.), RV.
पर्य्-उद्-√ 5. वस् Caus. -वासयति, to take away, remove, AV.
पर्य्-उद्-√ विज् (only fut. -विजिष्यति). to shrink from, be afraid of (acc.), R.
पर्य्-उप-√ लिप् P. -लिम्पति, to smear all round, Gobh.
पर्य्-उप-√ विश् P. -विशति, to sit down round or near (acc.), ŚBr.; ŚrS.
पर्य्-उप-˚वेशन n. sitting about, KātyŚr.
पर्य्-उप-˚स्थान n. waiting upon, serving, R.
rising, elevation, L.
पर्य्-उप-˚स्थापक mfn. leading to or upon, KātyŚr., Sch.
पर्य्-उप-˚स्थित mfn. standing round, surrounding (acc.), MBh.; R.
drawing nigh, imminent, impending, ib.
slipped, escaped (as a word), R.
intent upon, devoted to (loc.), ib.
पर्य्-उप-√ स्पृश् (only ind.p. -स्पृश्य), to touch or use (water) for the use of ablution or bathing, MBh.
पर्य्-उप-√ ह्वे Ā. -ह॑वते, to call near, invite, RV.
पर्य्-उपागत mfn. (√ गम्) standing round, surrounding, BhP.
पर्य्-उपा-वृत्त mfn. (√ वृत्) returned, come back, R.
पर्य्-˚उपासक mfn. worshipping, a worshipper, MBh.; BhP.
पर्य्-˚उपासन n. sitting round, Śak. i, 25/26 (in Prākṛt)
encamping round, MBh.
friendliness, courtesy, Pratāp.
pardon, excuse, Sāh.
honour, service, worship, Kāraṇḍ. (also f(आ). , Divyāv.)
joining in or concurrence with any act of reverence, W.
पर्य्-˚उपासित mfn. shared in, witnessed, MBh.
worshipped, reverenced
पर्य्-˚उपासित—पूर्व-त्व n. the having r˚ in a former birth, Divyāv.
पर्य्-˚उपासितृ mfn. moving round or about (acc.), MBh.
showing respect or honour, a worshipper, ib.
पर्य्-˚उपासीन mfn. sitting upon, Mn. ii, 75
surrounded by (instr.), R.
पर्य्-˚उपास्य mfn. to be worshipped or served, Jātakam.
पर्य्-उलूखलम् ind. g. परिमुखादि.
पर्य्-√ ऊर्णु Ā. -ऊर्णुते, to cover or conceal one's self, MaitrS.
पर्य्-√ 1. ऊह् P. Ā. -ऊहति, ˚ते, (impf. -औहत्), to heap or pile round, to surround with mounds or embankments, AV.; VS.; TS.; Br.
पर्य्-˚ऊहन n. sweeping or heaping together, KātyŚr.
पर्य्-√ 1. ऋष् P. पर्य्-अ॑र्षति, to flow round, to procure from every side by flowing, RV.
पर्य्-√ 2. ऋष् P. -ऋषति, (3. pl. aor. पर्य्-आरिषन् = -आर्षन्), to embrace, clasp round, support, Br.; KātyŚr.
पर्योग m. or n. (for परि-य्˚; cf. पर्याण for परि-य्˚) a kind of vehicle, Car.
पर्य्-ओष्ठम् ind. g. परि-मुखादि.
पार्य mfn. being on the opposite side or bank, TS.
upper, VS.
last, final, decisive, R.
helping through, effective, successful, ib.
पार्य n. end, issue, decision, ib.
पार्य See under 1. पार, p. 620.
पार्य् in comp. for पारि before vowels.
पार्य्—आप्तिक mfn. one who has said पर्य्-आप्तम् i.e., ‘enough’, Pāṇ. iv, 1, Vārtt. 2.
पार्य्—उलूखल्य mfn. (fr. पर्य्-उलूखलम्) g. परि-मुखादि, on Pāṇ. iv, 3, 58, Vārtt. 1.
पार्य्—ओष्ठ्य mfn. (fr. पर्योष्ठ्यम्), ib.
